title: Getting in Contract with Large Language Models – An Agency Theory Perspective on Large Language Model Alignment
reasoning: The paper focuses on Large Language Model (LLM) alignment, which is defined as aligning models with 'human, organizational, and social values'. It explicitly discusses and categorizes alignment approaches related to ethics, including the FATE (Fairness, Accountability, Transparency, and Ethics) framework and the 'ethicality' criteria (RICE), positioning ethical alignment as a core component of its proposed LLM ATLAS framework.
